statement: Honda's wire colour letters on the 2025 and 2026 CRF450R: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray. Two colours with a slash mean a base colour with a stripe, so Y/R is yellow with a red stripe.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda 2025 CRF450R/RX/RWE/R-S competition handbook, wiring diagram page 3-23

topic: Electrical components on the wiring diagram
statement: The 2025 and 2026 CRF450R wiring diagram shows: the ECM (one 33-pin black connector), alternator, regulator/rectifier, 12 V 2.3 Ah battery, starter motor, starter relay switch with a 10 A fuse, a starter/main relay unit with a diode, fuel pump unit, fuel injector, ignition coil and spark plug, crank position (CKP) sensor, throttle position (TP) sensor, intake pressure (MAP) sensor, intake air temperature (IAT) sensor, coolant temperature (ECT) sensor, gear position switch, the starter switch, and the left handlebar switch with the engine stop, engine mode select and HSTC (traction control) buttons and their blue, orange and green indicator LEDs. There is also a 4-pin data link connector (DLC) for diagnostics.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda 2025 CRF450R/RX/RWE/R-S competition handbook, wiring diagram page 3-23

statement: ECM pinout on the 2025 and 2026 CRF450R (33-pin connector, pin: signal, wire colour). A-1 IGP power in, black. A-2 PRC, white/black. A-3 HSTC indicator, gray. A-4 injector, pink. A-5 map mode indicator, blue. A-6 PG1 ground, green/black. A-7 warning indicator, orange. A-9 starter relay, yellow/black. A-10 fuel pump, white. A-11 ignition coil, yellow/blue. A-12 VCC 5 V sensor supply, red/yellow. A-15 throttle position signal, yellow. A-17 SG sensor ground, green/red. A-18 gear position, brown. A-19 intake air temperature, gray. A-21 coolant temperature, pink. A-22 PG2 ground, green. A-23 and A-24 crank position sensor, blue/yellow and white/yellow. A-26 K-line diagnostics, orange/black. A-27 intake pressure signal, light blue. A-28 SCS service check, brown. A-29 starter switch, blue/black. A-30 HSTC switch, yellow/red. A-31 map mode switch, light green. A-32 engine stop switch, white. A-33 LG logic ground, green. Pins A-8, A-13, A-14, A-16, A-20 and A-25 are empty.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda 2025 CRF450R/RX/RWE/R-S competition handbook, wiring diagram page 3-23

statement: Sensor wiring on the 2025 and 2026 CRF450R. The three-wire sensors share the red/yellow 5 V supply and the green/red sensor ground. Throttle position sensor: red/yellow, green/red and a yellow signal wire. Intake pressure (MAP) sensor: red/yellow, green/red and a light blue signal wire. Intake air temperature sensor: gray signal and green/red ground. Coolant temperature sensor: pink signal and green/red ground. Crank position sensor: blue/yellow and white/yellow. Gear position switch: brown to the ECM, grounded through the switch. Fuel injector: black power feed and a pink wire switched by the ECM. Ignition coil: yellow/blue from the ECM on the coil's black (+) terminal and a green ground wire on its green (-) terminal. Fuel pump: black power feed and a white wire switched by the ECM.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda 2025 CRF450R/RX/RWE/R-S competition handbook, wiring diagram page 3-23

statement: Left handlebar switches on the 2025 and 2026 CRF450R each connect one ECM wire to ground when pressed: engine stop is white, engine mode select is light green and HSTC is yellow/red; the common ground is green. The starter switch uses blue/black. The three indicator LEDs each run through a resistor: blue for the mode indicator on a blue wire, orange for the warning light on an orange wire and green for HSTC on a gray wire. To check a switch, look for continuity between its wire and green with the button pressed and none with it released.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda 2025 CRF450R/RX/RWE/R-S competition handbook, wiring diagram page 3-23

statement: Charging and starting on the 2025 and 2026 CRF450R: the alternator feeds the regulator/rectifier through three yellow wires, and the regulator's output charges a 12 V 2.3 Ah battery. A 10 A fuse sits at the starter relay switch. A combined starter/main relay unit with a diode powers the bike: the main relay feeds the black power wires to the ECM, injector and fuel pump. The starter switch signals the ECM on blue/black, and the ECM drives the starter relay on yellow/black. Battery negative and the engine ground wires are green.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

statement: ECM pinout on the 2026 CRF450R and CRF450RX, as pin, Honda's signal label and wire colour: A-1 IGP (power in), black; A-2 PRC, white/black; A-3 HSTC IND (HSTC indicator light), gray; A-4 INJ (fuel injector), pink; A-5 MAP MODE IND (mode indicator light), blue; A-6 PG1 (power ground), green/black; A-7 WARN (warning indicator), orange; A-9 ST-RLY (starter relay), yellow/black; A-10 FLP (fuel pump), white; A-11 IG (ignition coil), yellow/blue; A-12 VCC (5 V sensor supply), red/yellow; A-15 TH (throttle position signal), yellow; A-17 SG (sensor ground), green/red; A-18 GP (gear position), brown; A-19 TA (intake air temperature signal), gray; A-21 TW (coolant temperature signal), pink; A-22 PG2 (power ground), green; A-23 PCM (crank position sensor), blue/yellow; A-24 PCP (crank position sensor), white/yellow; A-26 K-LINE (diagnostic line), orange/black; A-27 PB (intake pressure (MAP) signal), light blue; A-28 SCS (service check), brown; A-29 ST-SW (starter switch), blue/black; A-30 HSTC SW (HSTC switch), yellow/red; A-31 MAP MODE SW (mode select switch), light green; A-32 ENG STOP SW (engine stop switch), white; A-33 LG (logic ground), green. Wire colours are base/stripe.

topic: Sensor and switch wire colours at the ECM
statement: Wire colours at the ECM on the 2026 CRF450R and CRF450RX: 5 V sensor supply red/yellow; sensor ground green/red; throttle position signal yellow; intake pressure signal light blue; intake air temperature signal gray; coolant temperature signal pink; crank position sensor blue/yellow and white/yellow; fuel injector (ECM side) pink; ignition coil (ECM side) yellow/blue; gear position brown; engine stop switch white; starter switch blue/black; diagnostic line orange/black. The three-wire sensors share the 5 V supply and the sensor ground. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.
